name: Mount Of Olives
overview: The Mount of Olives holds significant prophetic and redemptive importance in Scripture. It is the place where Jesus often taught His disciples, including delivering the Olivet Discourse about the end times and His coming (Matthew 24:3; Mark 13:1). It is also the location near Jerusalem where Jesus sent His disciples before His triumphal entry (Matthew 21:1) and where He and His followers went after the Last Supper (Mark 14:26). Zechariah 14:4 foretells a future day when the Lord will stand on the Mount of Olives, causing it to split and creating a great valley, pointing to the mountain’s role in the coming kingdom of Christ.
